text: from helping me: Heb. from my salvation
am not silent: Heb. there is no silence to me
He trusted on the LORD: Heb. He rolled himself on the Lord | seeing he delighted in him: Or, if he delight in him
didst make me hope: Or, keptest me in safety
none to help: Heb. not a helper
gaped upon me with their mouths: Heb. opened their mouths against me
my darling: Heb. my only one | from the power: Heb. from the hand
